manifest.profileDescription: What the DCB consistency check costs over an unconditional append, and how that grows with the number of OR-ed facts a decision rests on. Walks append-none through to a ten-item filter, single threaded, so the number is the check itself rather than contention for it. On PostgreSQL the unconditional append is also the only one taking no advisory lock, so the first step of the curve is the whole mechanism and the rest is the predicate widening.
